identity: Jund grindy-value midrange whose engine is the conversion of surplus lands into cards. Twelve of the twenty-three nonland cards can put a land into the graveyard - Sprouting Goblin and Goblin Picker as repeatable tap outlets, Thrill of Possibility and Shadow Prophecy at instant speed, Braids at every end step, Liliana every turn, Soul of Windgrace at will, Uurg on every upkeep - and every land that reaches the bin is a point of power on Uurg, Spawn of Turg, whose power is literally the count of land cards in your graveyard. Soul of Windgrace and Urborg Repossession recycle those same lands back into play or into hand, so the resource is rented rather than spent. The game ends with combat damage from a 4-7 power Uurg, a 5/4 Soul of Windgrace that rebuys a land on every attack, and Sheoldred draining two life on each of the deck's many draws, backed by seven pieces of removal and Nemata, Primeval Warden exiling everything that dies on the other side of the table.

mainboard.role: Interaction — 1-mana instant removal

mainboard.name: Lightning Strike
mainboard.oracle_text: Lightning Strike deals 3 damage to any target.
mainboard.role: Interaction — 3 damage any target

mainboard.name: Tear Asunder
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{B} (You may pay an additional {1}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Exile target artifact or enchantment. If this spell was kicked, exile target nonland permanent instead.
mainboard.role: Interaction — modal exile (kicked: any nonland permanent)

mainboard.name: Extinguish the Light
mainboard.oracle_text: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. If its mana value was 3 or less, you gain 3 life.
mainboard.role: Interaction — unconditional creature/PW removal

mainboard.name: Liliana of the Veil
mainboard.oracle_text:
+1: Each player discards a card.
−2: Target player sacrifices a creature.
−6: Separate all permanents target player controls into two piles. That player sacrifices all permanents in the pile of their choice.
mainboard.role: Interaction — symmetric discard (bins our lands) + edict

mainboard.name: Sprouting Goblin
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {G} (You may pay an additional {G} as you cast this spell.)
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, search your library for a land card with a basic land type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
{R}, {T}, Sacrifice a land: Draw a card.
mainboard.role: Engine — {R},{T}, Sac a land: Draw a card

mainboard.name: Goblin Picker
mainboard.oracle_text: {R}, {T}, Discard a card: Draw a card.
mainboard.role: Engine — {R},{T}, Discard a card: Draw a card

mainboard.name: Thrill of Possibility
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
Draw two cards.
mainboard.role: Engine — discard a land, draw two

mainboard.name: Urborg Repossession
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{G} (You may pay an additional {1}{G} as you cast this spell.)
Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. You gain 2 life. If this spell was kicked, return another target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
mainboard.role: Payoff — kicked, returns a land AND a creature from the graveyard to hand

mainboard.name: Uurg, Spawn of Turg
mainboard.oracle_text:
Uurg's power is equal to the number of land cards in your graveyard.
At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card into your graveyard.)
{B}{G}, Sacrifice a land: You gain 2 life.
mainboard.role: Payoff — power = land cards in your graveyard; upkeep surveil; sac-a-land outlet

mainboard.name: Braids, Arisen Nightmare
mainboard.oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, you may sacrifice an artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker. If you do, each opponent may sacrifice a permanent of their choice that shares a card type with it. For each opponent who doesn't, that player loses 2 life and you draw a card.
mainboard.role: Engine — end-step land sacrifice into draw/drain

mainboard.name: Soul of Windgrace
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever Soul of Windgrace enters or attacks, you may put a land card from a graveyard onto the battlefield tapped under your control.
{G}, Discard a land card: You gain 3 life.
{1}{R}, Discard a land card: Draw a card.
{2}{B}, Discard a land card: Soul of Windgrace gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
mainboard.role: Payoff/Engine — replays lands from graveyard; discard-a-land outlets

mainboard.name: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse
mainboard.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
Whenever you draw a card, you gain 2 life.
Whenever an opponent draws a card, they lose 2 life.
mainboard.role: Threat — 4/5 deathtouch; drain on every draw

mainboard.name: Shadow Prophecy
mainboard.oracle_text: Domain — Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. Put up to two of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. You lose 2 life.
mainboard.role: Engine - instant-speed dig that bins the remainder (judge-credited keystone, restored)

mainboard.name: Yavimaya Iconoclast
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {R} (You may pay an additional {R} as you cast this spell.)
Trample
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, it gets +1/+1 and gains haste until end of turn.
mainboard.role: Threat - 3/2 trample two-drop; kicked {R} for +1/+1 and haste

mainboard.name: Nemata, Primeval Warden
mainboard.oracle_text:
Reach
If a creature an opponent controls would die, exile it instead. When you do, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
{G}, Sacrifice a Saproling: Nemata gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
{1}{B}, Sacrifice two Saprolings: Draw a card.
mainboard.role: Threat/Answer - exiles opposing creatures that would die (graveyard hate), reach, Saproling draw outlet

identity_es: Midrange Jund de valor machacón cuyo motor es la conversión de tierras sobrantes en cartas. Doce de las veintitrés cartas no-tierra pueden poner una tierra en el cementerio — Sprouting Goblin y Goblin Picker como medios repetibles de giro, Thrill of Possibility y Shadow Prophecy a velocidad de instantáneo, Braids en cada paso final, Liliana cada turno, Soul of Windgrace a voluntad, Uurg en cada mantenimiento — y cada tierra que llega al cementerio es un punto de fuerza en Uurg, Spawn of Turg, cuya fuerza es literalmente el recuento de cartas de tierra en tu cementerio. Soul of Windgrace y Urborg Repossession reciclan esas mismas tierras de vuelta al juego o a la mano, así que el recurso se alquila en lugar de gastarse. La partida termina con daño de combate de un Uurg de 4-7 de fuerza, un Soul of Windgrace 5/4 que recompra una tierra en cada ataque, y Sheoldred drenando dos vidas en cada uno de los muchos robos del mazo, respaldado por siete piezas de eliminación y Nemata, Primeval Warden exiliando todo lo que muere al otro lado de la mesa.
